> A phone stand that uses LED matrices to display the phone's battery state(Low or high) and to warn the user of buzzes in the phone with lights. It uses an ESP32 and needs software like Tasker or Macrodroid in the Android phone for the notifications of the phone to link with the microcontroller. Alternatively, it can use an Accelerometer to just detect buzzes.
